messages:
laura.marketing: Quick sync  proposing a 10-day refapp sprint: tiny OSS refapp, 3 snack tutorials, and a reproducible perf note. Main goals: GH traction, signups, and a benchmark for the blog.

sam.devrel: Yes please. Tutorials: Quickstart (10m), Latency tuning (12m), Add a model (15m). Include copy-paste snippets and Docker dev image.

jules.eng: I'll run a perf harness on g6 & g5: fp16 vs int4, seq=128, batch [1,4]. ETA ~30h. launchbot: perf-job scheduled at 04:10 UTC.

emi.content: I'll draft the blog and 2 social threads (launch + dev thread). Need bench CSV, a short eng quote, and repo link.

mark.growth: For inbound routing: gated download -> if paying_customer -> acct-exec; elif company_size>=75 or monthly_tokens>=150k -> sdr; elif github_contrib==true -> devrel-nurture; else -> marketing-drip. We'll tweak after 100 signups.

nina.sales: Add rule: mention of "on-prem" or "dedicated" => AE+solutions. Also flag any paying_customer always route to AE.

laura.marketing: Messaging options: A) "Refapp Spark: a tiny, reproducible starter to ship LLM features" B) "Bench-backed refapp for predictable inference costs" We'll A/B test hero and CTA.

sam.devrel: Add a mini-eval notebook and CONTRIBUTING.md so maintainers can reproduce and PR. Also small maintainer welcome pack.

jules.eng: Bench done  early: g6 int4 batch1 seq128 -> ~2.1x tokens/sec vs fp16. Uploading CSV+readme to repo.

emi.content: Got CSV. Draft will call out model, seq len, batch, region, and include reproducible script link. Tone: developer-first and transparent.

laura.marketing: Timeline: prep 0-3d, community soft launch day 7, public blog day 10, webinar day 13. Action items: jules -> bench artifacts (24h), sam -> tutorials + vids (5d), emi -> post + social drafts (48h), mark -> landing + routing (48h), nina -> SDR playbook (48h). Sync in 24. :rocket:
